description_en: Queries the details of the custom key for Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) of an ApsaraDB Tair (Redis® OSS-Compatible) database instance
description_zh: 查询云数据库 Tair（兼容 Redis）实例的透明数据加密TDE自定义密钥的详情
name: DescribeEncryptionKey

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473778.html operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom key for the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473860.html operation to query the ID
parameters.help_zh: 实例的自定义密钥ID，可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/473860.html接口查询
parameters.name: encryption_key

Creator.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that created the key

DeleteDate.description_en: The scheduled deletion time of the instance key. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC. If this parameter is empty, the key is not automatically deleted
DeleteDate.description_zh: 实例密钥的预计删除时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 本参数返回内容为空时，表示密钥不会被自动删除

Description.description_en: The description of the key. This parameter is empty by default
Description.description_zh: 密钥的描述信息，默认为空

EncryptionKey.description_en: The ID of the instance key

EncryptionKeyStatus.description_en:
The status of the instance key. Valid values:
Enabled: Available.
Disabled: Unavailable
EncryptionKeyStatus.description_zh:
实例的密钥状态，返回值：
Enabled：可用。
Disabled：不可用

KeyUsage.description_en: The purpose of the instance key. A value of `ENCRYPT/DECRYPT` indicates encryption and decryption
KeyUsage.description_zh: 实例密钥的用途，返回值`ENCRYPT/DECRYPT`即表示加密和解密

MaterialExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the key. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC. If this parameter is empty, the key does not expire
MaterialExpireTime.description_zh: 密钥的过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 本参数返回内容为空时，表示密钥不会过期

Origin.description_en: The source of the key material. A value of Aliyun_KMS indicates Alibaba Cloud [Key Management Service (KMS)]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28935.html）
Origin.description_zh: 密钥材料的来源，返回值Aliyun_KMS，即表示阿里云[密钥管理服务KMS]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/28935.html）

RoleArn.description_en: The global resource descriptor Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN) of the role for authorization
RoleArn.description_zh: 指定待授权角色的全局资源描述符ARN（Alibaba Cloud Resource Name）信息
